softAsk.title: Get a notification when the master confirms
softAsk.titleBooked: Get a reminder before your visit
softAsk.textPhone: On this phone, even with the app closed. Reminders and changes to your visit arrive the same way.
softAsk.textDevice: On this device, even with the app closed. Reminders and changes to your visit arrive the same way.
softAsk.staffTitle: Hear about new bookings right away
softAsk.staffText: New booking requests arrive on this device and need a quick answer.

hint.install: On iPhone, notifications need the app on your Home Screen.
hint.unblockIos: Turn them on in Settings → Notifications → {{app}}.
hint.unblockAndroid: Allow them in the phone's Settings → Apps → Chrome (or Nails by Alynna) → Notifications.
hint.unblockDesktop: Allow them with the icon next to the address bar.
hint.notHerePhone: This phone isn't getting app notifications yet.
hint.notHereDevice: This device isn't getting app notifications yet.
hint.unsupported: This browser can't show app notifications.
hint.preview: App notifications work in the published app, not in this preview.

prompt.clientText: We'll tell you on this phone, and by email:
prompt.clientTextDevice: We'll tell you on this device, and by email:

clientPoints.confirm: when the master confirms or moves your visit
clientPoints.remind: before each visit, so you don't miss it
clientPoints.loyalty: when your loyalty card earns a discount

prompt.staffText: New booking requests arrive here and need a quick answer. With notifications on, you see them even when the app is closed.

staffPoints.requests: new booking requests, the moment they arrive

prompt.installText: Add the app to your Home Screen first: notifications arrive there, even when it's closed.

result.onPhone: Notifications are on for this phone.
result.onDevice: Notifications are on for this device.
result.dismissed: No problem. You can turn them on any time in Profile → Notifications.
result.notReady: Notifications are still getting ready on this device. Try again in a moment.
result.saveFailed: Notifications are on, but your choices weren't saved. Check them in Profile → Notifications.
result.subscribeFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications on this device right now. Check your connection and try again.

banner.staffBlocked: Notifications are blocked on this device: new booking requests won't reach you.

test.countdownHint: Lock the phone or close the app now to see it arrive.
test.none: No device got it. Turn notifications off and on again on this phone.
test.lost: If the notification arrived, everything works. If not, check that notifications are allowed for this app in the phone's settings.
